metadata.description: Apify Agent Skills for SEO and Amazon sellers (doesaiknow Actors)

plugins.name: apify-amazon-listing-launch-kit
plugins.description: Builds a verified keyword set and a launch-day rank baseline for an Amazon listing. Pulls the keywords 1-3 competitor ASINs rank for (reverse ASIN), adds estimated Amazon search volume for the user's own seed terms, drops competitor brands and off-product terms, maps each keyword to the title, bullets or backend search terms, drafts a title and bullets from the user's real product facts (flagged for review), and records where the user's ASIN ranks today. Runs the doesaiknow Amazon Keyword Research, Amazon Listing Optimizer and Amazon Rank Tracker Actors on Apify. Use when the user is launching or relaunching an Amazon product, asks which keywords to put in a listing title, bullets or backend, wants a Cerebro-style reverse-ASIN keyword list turned into listing copy, or wants to know where a new listing ranks before changes. Needs at least one competitor ASIN; not for ongoing rank monitoring, product prices, reviews or sales estimates.

plugins.name: apify-amazon-rank-watch
plugins.description: Watches where an Amazon seller's ASINs rank for their keywords and reports what changed since the last check. Runs the doesaiknow Amazon Rank Tracker with a persistent watchlist ID (optionally after a reverse-ASIN lookup to pick the keywords), then reports drops and gains per keyword, which competitor ASINs overtook the user, exits from the organic top 10 and share of the top 10. The first measurement is a baseline with no change data, and the skill says so. Use when the user wants to track Amazon keyword rankings over time, asks whether their positions dropped, who overtook them, why sales from search fell, or wants a weekly or daily Amazon rank report. Scheduling (Apify Schedules, n8n) is described as an option, never created automatically. Needs at least one ASIN. Not for choosing which keywords to put in a new or existing listing, writing titles or bullets (a listing launch task), product prices, reviews or Google rankings.

plugins.name: apify-seo-content-gap-plan
plugins.description: Turns a competitor keyword gap into a prioritized SEO content plan. Finds the Google keywords that 1-3 competitor domains rank for where the user's site ranks lower or not at all, drops brand and off-topic terms, clusters the rest into topics, scores every cluster (gap volume x ease x intent x business fit) and writes a backlog CSV plus content briefs for the top clusters. Runs the doesaiknow Competitor Keywords Actor (gap mode) and the AI Keyword Clustering Actor on Apify. Use when the user asks what to write next, which topics competitors get traffic from that they do not, for a content gap or keyword gap analysis against named competitor domains, a content roadmap or topical map built from competitor rankings, or a ranked list of blog posts and landing pages to create. Needs competitor domains; not for backlink gaps, AI Overview tracking, rank checks, or volume lookups and clustering of a keyword list the user already has.
